TourlyFaqs1.subtitle: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
TourlyFaqs1.description: Find quick answers to common questions about tour booking, payments, cancellations, and travel requirements.

leftFaqs.question: What types of tour packages do you offer?
leftFaqs.answer: We offer a wide range of tour packages including domestic tours, international tours, honeymoon packages, family vacations, adventure tours, group tours and customized travel packages to suit your preferences and budget.

leftFaqs.question: How can I book a tour with Tourly?
leftFaqs.answer: You can easily book a tour online through our website by selecting your destination, choosing your preferred dates, and submitting an enquiry. Alternatively, you can call our travel consultants directly.

leftFaqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
leftFaqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, net banking, UPI, wire transfers, and popular digital wallets for secure and hassle-free transactions.

leftFaqs.question: Can I customize my travel package?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! We specialize in tailoring custom holiday itineraries based on your preferred travel dates, hotel preferences, budget, and specific activities.

leftFaqs.question: Do you provide international tour packages?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive international tour packages to popular destinations including Europe, Dubai, Maldives, Bali, Thailand, Singapore, and more.

leftFaqs.question: What is included in a tour package?
leftFaqs.answer: Our standard packages typically include hotel accommodations, daily breakfast, airport transfers, guided sightseeing, and select entrance fees. Specific inclusions vary per package.

leftFaqs.question: Are flights and hotels included in the package?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes, our packages can be booked with or without flights. Premium 3-star, 4-star, and 5-star hotel stays with daily breakfast are standard inclusions.
